//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"embed"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/jchv/go-webview2"
)

// {{APP_ID}} is the stable per-application user-data folder name.
// {{WINDOW_TITLE}} is the window title.
// {{WIDTH}}/{{HEIGHT}} are initial dimensions; {{RESIZABLE}} toggles resize.
// {{ENTRY_FILE}} is the entry HTML file name within the embedded FS.
// {{REMOTE_URL}} is the URL for remote-URL builds (when MODE_LOCAL is false).
// {{MODE_LOCAL}} selects local-vs-remote embedding mode.
// {{WEB_SUBDIR}} is the subdir within the EXE that holds the web content.
// {{DEBUG}} toggles verbose WebView output.
//
// At build time, these placeholders are filled in by w2e's builder package.
//
// Windows host: pulls in the pure-Go go-webview2 binding so the produced EXE
// stays clang-free and CGO-free. The Linux/macOS builds use webview_go.

const (
	appID         = "{{APP_ID}}"
	windowTitle   = "{{WINDOW_TITLE}}"
	width         = {{WIDTH}}
	height        = {{HEIGHT}}
	resizableTrue = {{RESIZABLE}}
	entry         = "{{ENTRY_FILE}}"
	remoteURL     = "{{REMOTE_URL}}"
	modeLocal     = {{MODE_LOCAL}}
	embedSubdir   = "{{WEB_SUBDIR}}"
	debugMode     = {{DEBUG}}
)

//go:embed all:{{WEB_SUBDIR}}
var webAssets embed.FS

func main() {
	runtime.LockOSThread()
	if modeLocal {
		runLocal()
	} else {
		runRemote()
	}
}

func runLocal() {
	subFS, err := fs.Sub(webAssets, embedSubdir)
	if err != nil {
	 showError("Failed to load embedded web assets: " + err.Error())
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	srv, err := newServer(subFS, entry)
	if err != nil {
		showError("Failed to start local server: " + err.Error())
		os.Exit(3)
	}
	go srv.Serve()
	defer srv.Shutdown()

	// Wait for the server to be ready before creating the WebView2 window.
	// The TCP listener is already bound, but we need to make sure the
	// accept loop is running so that incoming connections are handled.
	waitForServer(srv.Addr(), 5*time.Second)

	w := webview2.NewWithOptions(webview2.WebViewOptions{
		Debug:    debugMode,
		DataPath: defaultUserDataFolder(appID),
		WindowOptions: webview2.WindowOptions{
			Title:  windowTitle,
			Width:  uint(width),
			Height: uint(height),
			Center: true,
		},
	})
	if w == nil {
		srv.Shutdown()
		showError("WebView2 Runtime not found. Install Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.")
		os.Exit(4)
	}
	if !resizableTrue {
		w.SetSize(width, height, webview2.HintFixed)
	} else {
		// Set minimum window size so the UI never collapses.
		w.SetSize(960, 600, webview2.HintMin)
	}
	installExternalNavGuard(w, srv.Addr())
	w.Navigate("http://" + srv.Addr() + "/")
	w.Run()
}

func runRemote() {
	w := webview2.NewWithOptions(webview2.WebViewOptions{
		Debug:    debugMode,
		DataPath: defaultUserDataFolder(appID),
		WindowOptions: webview2.WindowOptions{
			Title:  windowTitle,
			Width:  uint(width),
			Height: uint(height),
			Center: true,
		},
	})
	if w == nil {
		showError("WebView2 Runtime not found. Install Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.")
		os.Exit(4)
	}
	if !resizableTrue {
		w.SetSize(width, height, webview2.HintFixed)
	} else {
		w.SetSize(960, 600, webview2.HintMin)
	}
	installExternalNavGuard(w, "")
	w.Navigate(remoteURL)
	w.Run()
}

// waitForServer polls the server address until it accepts a TCP connection
// or the timeout expires. This prevents WebView2 from navigating before the
// server's accept loop is running.
func waitForServer(addr string, timeout time.Duration) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, 500*time.Millisecond)
		if err == nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	// If we can't connect within timeout, proceed anyway — the OS TCP
	// backlog may still queue the connection.
}

// showError displays a simple message box when the WebView2 window can't
// be created (e.g. Runtime not installed).
func showError(msg string) {
	procMessageBox := syscall.NewLazyDLL("user32.dll").NewProc("MessageBoxW")
	title, _ := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(windowTitle)
	text, _ := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(msg)
	procMessageBox.Call(0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(text)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(title)), 0)
}

// installExternalNavGuard injects JS that intercepts window.open and anchor
// clicks to external origins; external targets are routed to the system
// default browser instead of replacing the app content (spec §51).
func installExternalNavGuard(w webview2.WebView, localAddr string) {
	policy := `console.log && console.log('[w2e] external-nav guard installed');window.__w2eLocalAddr = "` + localAddr + `";(function(){
var inLocal = function(u){
  if(!u) return true;
  if(u.indexOf('http://127.0.0.1') === 0 || u.indexOf('http://localhost') === 0 || u.indexOf('http://[') === 0) {
    if(!window.__w2eLocalAddr || u.indexOf('http://'+window.__w2eLocalAddr) === 0) return true;
    return true;
  }
  return (u.indexOf('data:') === 0) || (u.indexOf('about:blank') === 0) || (u.indexOf('blob:') === 0) || (u.indexOf('javascript:') === 0);
};
var open = window.open;
window.open = function(url){
  try { if(!inLocal(url)) { window.__ext(url); return null; } } catch(e) {}
  return open && open.apply(this, arguments);
};
document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
  var a = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('a') : null;
  if(!a) return;
  var href = a.getAttribute('href');
  if(!href) return;
  if(!inLocal(href) && (a.target === '_blank' || (ev.metaKey || ev.ctrlKey))) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    try { window.__ext(href); } catch(e) {}
  }
}, true);
})();`
	w.Init(policy)
	_ = w.Bind("__ext", func(url string) {
		openExternalBrowser(url)
	})
}

func openExternalBrowser(u string) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(u, "http://") && !strings.HasPrefix(u, "https://") {
		return
	}
	_ = exec.Command("rundll32.exe", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", u).Start()
}

func defaultUserDataFolder(appID string) string {
	la := os.Getenv("LOCALAPPDATA")
	if la == "" {
		la = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "w2e")
	}
	return filepath.Join(la, "w2e", appID)
}

// --- embedded HTTP server ------------------------------------------------

type httpServer struct {
	ln    net.Listener
	srv   *http.Server
	fsys  fs.FS
	index string
}

func newServer(fsys fs.FS, index string) (*httpServer, error) {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hs := &httpServer{ln: ln, fsys: fsys, index: index}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/", hs.handle)
	hs.srv = &http.Server{
		Handler:           mux,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
		ReadTimeout:        30 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout:       60 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:        120 * time.Second,
	}
	return hs, nil
}

func (s *httpServer) Addr() string { return s.ln.Addr().String() }
func (s *httpServer) Serve() error { return s.srv.Serve(s.ln) }
func (s *httpServer) Shutdown() error {
	if s.srv != nil {
		return s.srv.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *httpServer) handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	urlPath := path.Clean("/" + r.URL.Path)
	if strings.Contains(urlPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	rel := strings.TrimPrefix(urlPath, "/")
	if rel == "" || strings.HasSuffix(rel, "/") {
		rel = path.Join(rel, s.index)
	}
	f, ct, err := openFromFS(s.fsys, s.index, rel)
	if err != nil {
		// SPA fallback: navigational routes serve the entry HTML.
		if ef, ect, eerr := openFromFS(s.fsys, s.index, s.index); eerr == nil {
			streamFile(w, r, ef, ect)
			return
		}
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	streamFile(w, r, f, ct)
}

func openFromFS(fsys fs.FS, index, rel string) (fs.File, string, error) {
	f, err := fsys.Open(rel)
	if err == nil {
		if st, serr := f.Stat(); serr == nil && st.IsDir() {
			_ = f.Close()
			f, err = fsys.Open(path.Join(rel, index))
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return f, mimeTypeFor(path.Ext(rel)), nil
}

func streamFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, f fs.File, contentType string) {
	defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
	st, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	rs, ok := f.(io.ReadSeeker)
	if !ok {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", contentType)
		_, _ = io.Copy(w, f)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", contentType)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, st.Name(), st.ModTime(), rs)
}

func mimeTypeFor(ext string) string {
	ext = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
	switch ext {
	case "", "html", "htm":
		return "text/html; charset=utf-8"
	case "css":
		return "text/css; charset=utf-8"
	case "js", "mjs":
		return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8"
	case "cjs":
		return "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
	case "json", "map":
		return "application/json; charset=utf-8"
	case "txt":
		return "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
	case "xml":
		return "application/xml; charset=utf-8"
	case "svg":
		return "image/svg+xml"
	case "png":
		return "image/png"
	case "jpg", "jpeg":
		return "image/jpeg"
	case "gif":
		return "image/gif"
	case "webp":
		return "image/webp"
	case "ico":
		return "image/x-icon"
	case "woff":
		return "font/woff"
	case "woff2":
		return "font/woff2"
	case "ttf":
		return "font/ttf"
	case "otf":
		return "font/otf"
	case "eot":
		return "application/vnd.ms-fontobject"
	case "wasm":
		return "application/wasm"
	case "mp4":
		return "video/mp4"
	case "webm":
		return "video/webm"
	case "mp3":
		return "audio/mpeg"
	case "pdf":
		return "application/pdf"
	}
	return "application/octet-stream"
}
